Filter where max_phase equals 4 and action_type equals 'BLOCKER'. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id as target_chembl_id, and pref_name as target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, and target_name.
